description: Fork-14 transactions (docs/tx-v2.md, docs/wallet-v2.md §7.2 D), mainnet addresses, fee 10, unlock time 0, dust threshold 0. Secrets and randomness are H_s("xkr tx-v2 vectors " || label). Inputs are in the caller's order (Rust keeps it; kryptokrona-utils sorts by key image, so JS must take the order given here), decoys in /getrandom_outs order, ring = decoys + real output sorted by global index, outputs sorted by amount (each listed with its owner). randomness lists every random_scalar draw of the build: r, then per input v2: alpha and the decoy responses s_{l+1}..s_{l-1}; v1: in ring order k at the real index and (c_i, r_i) elsewhere. Compare extra bytes as given. Generated and checked by crates/xkr-wallet-core/tests/tx_v2_transactions/.
